sb_prompt: WHAT HOBBIES DO YOU HAVE IN YOUR SPARE TIME?  DO THEY INCLUDE ANY HANDICRAFTSWOODWORKING?
turns:
I'm doing okay, thanks. You?

Yes, I do have some hobbies. I enjoy painting, mostly watercolors. How about you?

Oh, nice! I've tried painting before, but I've never really gotten the hang of it. I've been more into knitting lately. It's relaxing, you know?

Yes, I've heard that. My grandmother was a great knitter. She taught me when I was younger, but I never really stuck with it. What do you make when you knit?

I've made scarves and hats. It's very satisfying to see a project come together, piece by piece. Have you ever tried any other crafts?

I've dabbled in a few things. I used to collect stamps as a kid, and I still have that hobby. I've also tried woodworking, but I found it to be a bit too challenging for me.

Ah, I see. Woodworking can be quite intimidating, especially if you don't have the right tools. I've always been a bit afraid of power tools. But I do appreciate the beauty of woodwork. Maybe I'll give it another try one day.

That's the spirit! Sometimes it takes a few attempts to really get the hang of something. Good luck with your hobbies!

Thanks! You too. Have a great day!

You too. Bye!

Bye!
